summary: Terrain H-tree file loader: opens the file via the audio-stream abstraction, validates a 46-byte version string against the expected literal and reads the header fields (three 8-byte geometry blocks into this[2]/this[4]/this[6]/this[8] and three 4-byte counts), allocates the main collision data buffer (92 bytes per object) and a collision-object array (16 bytes per node), then deserializes the collision tree and frees scratch buffers. Returns 0 on success, -1 after cleanup on any validation or read failure.

local_names.v16: terrain entry count (drives scratch entry buffer size)
local_names.v17: collision node count (drives collision object array)
local_names.v20: cleanup tracking struct zeroed at entry
local_names.v23: pointer to initialized collision object array (this[1])
local_names.v25: scratch entry buffer freed before exit

operations.description: Zero-initialize the cleanup tracking struct v20 via ZeroInitSmallStruct(v20).
Open the file for reading via AudioStreamOpen(a2, 0).
Combined validation guard: open failure (v20[0] null), short 46-byte version read, version string mismatch, short reads of any header block or count all route to the error-cleanup path (LABEL_26).
Read the 46-byte version string via FileWriteWithBackendDispatch(v19, 46), expecting exactly 46 bytes.
Compare the read version string against the expected literal aVer006ThisFile.
Read the first 8-byte header block into this+2 (dword index 2) via FileWriteWithBackendDispatch.
Read three further 8-byte header blocks into this+4, this+6 and this+8 via FileWriteWithBackendDispatch.
Read three 4-byte counts into v18, v17 and v16 via FileWriteWithBackendDispatch.
Allocate the main collision data buffer with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(92 * v18), store it at *this and track it in v20[9].
Allocate the collision-object array with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(16 * v17 + 4); on success store the count at the leading word and iterate the body.
do-while loop over v17 collision nodes calling CollisionObjectInit(v8) on each 16-byte slot.
Store the collision-object array pointer in this[1] (and mirror it in v23).
Allocate the scratch entry buffer with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(16 * v16) as v25.
Loop over v16 entries reading 4+8+4 bytes per entry into the scratch buffer; any short read jumps to the failure cleanup (LABEL_24).
Tree deserialization runs only when v17 (node count) is greater than zero; sets v21 = 1 before it.
Deserialize collision tree nodes via CollisionTreeNodeDeserializer(v23, v20); a non-zero return triggers failure cleanup.
Free the scratch buffer v25 via FreeWrapper_7bcf(v25) on both the failure and success paths.
Error path: run SubCallWithConditionalFieldFree(v20) and return -1.
On success, close the file handle via ConditionalFileHandleCloseWithFlagDispatch(v20), then run SubCallWithConditionalFieldFree(v20).
Return 0 on successful load.
